obligations.note: The change sets payments.privileged_idle_minutes to 16 in both policy.py and policy-params.json, exceeding the obligation's parametric bound of ≤ 15 minutes. No valid exception covers this: EXC-0141 (payments.session) expired on 2026-09-19, and EXC-0210 (cited in the ticket) is scoped to 'mortgage.session', not payments.
Ticket CHG-24034 is approved by Erik Brandt (change_manager) and its components (payments.controls-data, payments.policy) cover every path the change touches.
Mara Costa (change_approver for payments) provided a code_review approval; she is not the author (Jonah Weiss) and shares no email address with him.
The single commit 63831d6… is the one named in both approvals; there are no later commits to void the approval.

CI ran on the final commit 63831d6… with 172 tests, 0 failures, 0 skipped, including the SES-1 control test test_privileged_idle_timeout_within_policy (which verifies code/param consistency, not the 15-minute regulatory bound).
Neither payments.policy (security_sensitive: false) nor payments.controls-data (security_sensitive: false) is marked security_sensitive, so no security_review approval is required.
controls/payments/policy-params.json is a protected path; Rachel Stein (control_owner, controls-office team) approved the commit, and she is outside the author's payments-eng team.
The ticket is type 'standard', not 'emergency', so the post-implementation review requirement does not apply.

The change deviates from SES-1 but the only payments-scoped exception (EXC-0141) expired 2026-09-19 (before the 2026-10-19 review time). The cited EXC-0210 is scoped to 'mortgage.session' and does not cover the payments component.
No entry in the acceptance ledger covers apps/baseline-payments/payments/policy.py or controls/payments/policy-params.json, so no prior evidence lapses from this change.

summary: The change increases payments's privileged idle timeout from 15 to 16 minutes, directly violating the SES-1 parametric bound (≤ 15 minutes). The ticket references exception EXC-0210, but that exception is scoped to 'mortgage.session', not the payments session component modified here. The only payments-scoped SES-1 exception (EXC-0141) expired on 2026-09-19, well before the 2026-10-19 review time. All change-management process obligations (ticket, independent approval, control-owner approval for protected paths, CI) are satisfied, but the product obligation SES-1 is refuted and no valid exception excuses the deviation, so the change must be rejected.
